test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes of the government of India is NOT correctly matched?

options.text: Ujjwala Yojana – Distribution of LPG cylinders to woman of BPL family
Ayushman Bharat – Health for All and Universal Health Coverage
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana – To promote the welfare of the Girl child

solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Mission Indradhanush -Employment for all.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Mission Indradhanush**

__
 
• A** health mission of the Government of India.**
 
• It was launched by** Union Health Minister J. P. Nadda on 25 December 2014**.
 
• The main objective is to **ensure full immunization with all available vaccines for children up to two years of age and pregnant women.**
 
• The diseases come under this scheme are: **polio, diphtheria, measles, whooping cough, hepatitis B, tetanus, meningitis, rubella, Japanese encephalitis and pneumonia.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• To boost this act: **Intensified Mission Indradhanush 2.0 **
 
• **IMI 2.0 **aims to achieve targets of full immunization coverage in** 272 districts in 27 States and in 652 blocks** in** Uttar Pradesh and Bihar **among hard-to-reach** and tribal populations.**
